fields.summary: TC-668-04: LCO Code R When Pilot Promoted From Deadhead to Flying on Original Flight (OR-08)

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-668

Precondition: A pilot was originally scheduled to deadhead a flight (Deadhead leg, isOriginal=true) and is involuntarily reassigned to operate (fly) that same original flight. Rule OR-08 applies (Original Deadhead Promote Rule). Out of Scope: LRO, RRO, Guarantees, Special Rules.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up trip V0 where the pilot is scheduled to deadhead a flight (isOriginal=true, legType=Deadhead)
V0: DAL->LAX, legType=Deadhead, isOriginal=true, position=FO
Trip V0 exists with pilot as Deadhead on DAL->LAX
Trigger an involuntary Save and Replace (V1) that upgrades the pilot from Deadhead to Flying operator on the same original flight
Same flight DAL->LAX, legType changed from Deadhead to Flying, changeType=INVOL, V1
Trip V1 created with pilot now flying the originally deadheaded DAL->LAX flight
Trigger the LCO Lambda on V1 of the trip
Involuntary promotion scenario: originally deadheading, now flying the same original flight
Lambda is invoked successfully without errors
Verify the LCO lambda applies deadhead-promotion override code R per rule OR-08
Original deadhead leg (isOriginal=true) now operated as Flying in V1, changeType=INVOL
lcoCode = R (eligible - deadhead promoted to flying on original leg)
Confirm the DB update lambda persists lcoCode = R for the promoted leg in DynamoDB
Lambda output payload with lcoCode=R on the promoted leg
DynamoDB record shows lcoCode = R on the promoted leg
